items.title: Protect sensitive data in your traces: new controls in LangSmith
items.en_title: Protect sensitive data in your traces: new controls in LangSmith
items.en_oneliner: LangSmith has added new access controls that help teams manage sensitive information inside trace data, so each member only sees what their permissions allow.

items.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
items.en_oneliner: The new Astra and Sol variants of GPT-6.2 deliver better professional output, coding, and computer use at lower cost, now live across the API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work.

items.title: Put Gemini to work for you
items.en_title: Put Gemini to work for you
items.en_oneliner: The Gemini app adds free task features: hand it something to get done, and it works on it in the background for you.

items.title: What We’ve Learned Building Proactive Agents
items.en_title: What We've Learned Building Proactive Agents
items.en_oneliner: LangChain reviews lessons from building GTM Agent and Robin: proactive agents push toward goals on their own and ask for input only when needed, with memory and interaction design deciding success.
